negative_reviews.author: akhyar mahmood
negative_reviews.text: This place uses the word Halal but serves alcohol. It's a mockery.

negative_reviews.author: Emily Cars
negative_reviews.text: Really disappointed with our experience. It took half an hour for anyone to just take our drink orders. The fried chicken starters were really chewy and rubbery. Both the ramen and yakisoba noodles seemed like they had just been heated in the microwave and lacked flavour. All the food had a strange artificial flavour as well. Would not recommend

negative_reviews.author: Amna Ahmed
negative_reviews.text: The chicken was overly salty, ramen lacked flavour other than salt. Chicken was also soggy. Katsu curry was average at best- the sauce was nice but chicken felt like frozen food you air fry. Rice was stiff. Staff were polite and served us quickly but the food is heavily lacking. Wouldn't return.

negative_reviews.author: Lib
negative_reviews.text:
Was a bit disappointed with how the food was. Ordered a chicken firecracker ramen and steak ramen and with the chicken one being 16 pound it had only about 3 pieces of chicken in it and not much flavor. Steak was somewhat better as it came with more portion of steak.

Initially our server told us they were out of steak ramen and we were going to leave but then another staff member said they did have it and fixed our order for us so that atleast worked out.

Overall it’s a nice built restaurant but the prices don’t match the quality of the food at all.

They should also communicate that the 5 pound ramen is only one per table as it’s providing false advertisement thinking both people can get ramen for 5 pound.

negative_reviews.author: Andy Miles
negative_reviews.text: Was totally ignored by serving staff for twenty minutes and left. Won't be returning.

negative_reviews.author: mina
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, we were disappointed with our experience at Maki & Ramen Birmingham. We waited around an hour for our food, and only half the order arrived initially. We had to ask for the rest of our food and drinks, then waited ages again to pay and leave. I’ve never experienced such a bad service before.

The music was also far too loud and overstimulating. The food was okay overall, with the sushi being the highlight, but the noodle broth arrived lukewarm.

Overall, the slow service and atmosphere really took away from what could have been a much better experience I’ve experienced at other branches. And I hope there’s improvement as it goes on.

negative_reviews.author: Fi Chai
negative_reviews.text: I don’t usually write reviews but I am extremely disappointed with the service I received today and should warn people if anyone wants to come here. Initially I came for the £5 ramen voucher however was told it can only be used once per table, even though we were a group of 3 different people, paying 3 separate bills. The atmosphere and vibe of the restaurant is catered more towards groups, it didn’t make sense for us to go and eat alone on different tables. Ordered anyways and was waiting for over than hour! A group of 3 came in after us and 3 couples, they ate and paid the bill. None of the servers noticed we were without food until I had to ask. Turns of an ingredient was out of stock and our order wasn’t even processed, so there was no communication between kitchen and staff. Left as the service and wait was getting ridiculous. They offered a £20 voucher to use as compensation but it’s probably only for one person per table. Wouldn’t recommend and won’t be coming here again.

negative_reviews.author: Rex Lapis
negative_reviews.text: waited for 1 hour and had to ask the servers when the food would arrive. Turns out they ran out of an ingredient which the chef did not communicate to the servers and we had to place an order again. was given a £20 coupon as compensation but this will probably be used for one per table as they do this with the £5 coupons. Better to go alone

negative_reviews.author: cherryq
negative_reviews.text: Came here with my friends and was planning to use our £5 coupons. Turned out we couldn’t use more than one coupon for one table so ordered anyways. We ordered our food, waited for over an hour and still didn’t get our food. One item on the menu was had ran out and no staff were notified so we ended up waiting for nothing. Absolutely no communication between any of the staff in the kitchen and taking orders. We left without our food and was offered coupons, which they had ready probably because this has happened more than once. Felt completely ignored and I won’t be coming here again.
